title: Genres with at least eight books
statementMd:
Which genres have at least 8 books?

Expected columns: `genre`, `books`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS books FROM books GROUP BY genre HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
